data.what_it_does: Adds interactive popup capabilities to markers in flutter_map. It supports customizable popup builders, snap options, animations, and works with multiple marker layers.
use_when: You are using flutter_map and need to display popups when markers are tapped
You need to manage popup states programmatically using a PopupController
avoid_when: You are using Google Maps or another mapping solution instead of flutter_map
You do not need marker popups
strengths: Provides a PopupController for programmatic control over popups
weaknesses: Conflicts with GestureDetector inside custom marker builders if not configured properly
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and configure alongside flutter_map.
data.minimal_example: // For a minimal code example have a look at SimpleMapWithPopups in the package repository.
